test_title: PYST 16: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3bb5ee67dde8d01ac29f2984a8c66290f9b67ccb675ae72b6b124b08fa19977.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) For shaded circles → Shift in the anticlockwise direction along with skipping an increasing number of sections or parts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/78c010623b3e4b5869af62fcedf96e44cb09573b13578fd0d7ccdf891e450208.png] 

2) For circle → Shift in the clockwise direction subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69585c176b5cde7e609af328482808c452e523f4055b963ac42bcd54b2cdb40b.png] 

Thus, the final series is:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/454248a920ec08a1e9811ab0ea824b44475b88fd488d99125a8e0099ee7cd685.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
